title: I Built This in Sipover's Redstone Competition
description:
We got invited to a redstone hosted by the one and only sipover. Finally an excuse to build the most absurd concept I had ever thought of, a blast chamber that uses the blast from a wither before deleting it with a hypersonic railgun. You cannot get any better than that, unless you're the competition. Be sure to check out the crazy builds from everyone involved:
